name: PARKS

categories.label: Visited Park cards (points)
categories.hint: Sum of the points printed on all your visited Park cards

categories.label: Photo Bonus Tile (most Photos)
categories.hint: 2-player: 3 pts for most Photos. 3-5 players: 4 pts most, 2 pts second most. Enter what you earned.

categories.label: Fall Season Bonus
categories.hint: 3 points if you have the most of the pictured requirement on visited Parks (ties all score)

categories.label: Passion Card end-game bonus
categories.hint: Only if you chose the end-game bonus on your Passion Card (1st edition: Year card, 2 or 3 pts)

categories.label: First Hiker Token
categories.hint: 1 point to the holder of the First Hiker token

tiebreakers.description: Tied player who visited the most Park cards wins (count of Parks, not points)
If still tied, tied players share the victory.

notes: family: set-collection. Rules from 2nd edition rulebook v1.1 (Photo Bonus Tile, Season Bonuses); 1st edition has no Photo Bonus/Fall bonus (these two categories optional) and uses Year cards instead of Passion cards. Tiebreaker is number of Parks visited, which is not a scored field. Solo and 2-player Ranger Teddy modes, Camping mode and Solo rank table (30-50 pts) not modelled. Photo Bonus tie handling not stated in rulebook; scorer enters points received.
